subject: Software Engineering
moduleDescription: Comprehensive study of searching algorithms — Linear O(n), Binary O(log n), Interpolation O(log log n), and Fibonacci O(log n) — followed by rigorous treatment of hash tables including hash function design (Division, Mid-Square, Folding), collision resolution via Separate Chaining and Open Addressing (Linear Probing, Quadratic Probing, Double Hashing), load factor analysis, and production applications in Java HashMap, compiler symbol tables, and distributed hash tables.
